comment: The BASE half of the cross-file override pair. `ExtBase` and its `{.base.}` render live in THIS file while the derived type and its overriding method live in extderived.nim, so an `overrides` edge between them cannot be derived from either file alone — it needs the project-wide companion index. This file is what the companion is BUILT from: `buildOverrideCompanion` turns its symbols into owner -> declared-method-names, which is why a method must declare `ownerName` (its receiver) for the index to see it at all.

expectSymbols.name: render
expectSymbols.comment: the receiver IS the owner: a Nim method belongs to its receiver type, and `ownerName` is the family-standard field that says so. Without it the method is invisible to every owner-based mechanism in the codebase, the companion index included

expectRelationships.comment: a method is owned by its receiver type

expectDecorators.comment: `{.base.}` marks the root of the override chain
